days.title: Marion to Fort Collins
days.summary: Long drive west. Reach Fort Collins and relax—tomorrow starts before sunrise.
days.driveSummary: Marion, IA to Fort Collins, CO. Longest drive of the trip.
days.eveningNote: Fuel up, pack the car for a pre-dawn start, and get to bed early.

days.title: RMNP Traverse to Grand Lake
days.summary: Enter Rocky Mountain National Park before the timed-entry window. Bear Lake first, then cross Trail Ridge Road and scan Kawuneeche Valley for moose before the drive to Moab.
days.heroMoment: Bear Lake sunrise and the Trail Ridge Road crossing
days.driveSummary: Fort Collins to Estes Park, across Trail Ridge Road, then south to Moab.
days.eveningNote: Check in at Hoodoo Moab for two nights. Hydrate—tomorrow is a hot one.

days.title: Arches National Park
days.summary: Beat the heat: Park Avenue, Balanced Rock, the Windows, Double Arch, and Delicate Arch viewpoints before afternoon temperatures peak.
days.heroMoment: Delicate Arch and the Windows cluster
days.driveSummary: Short loop from Moab into Arches and back.
days.eveningNote: Second night at Hoodoo Moab. Relax by the pool.

days.title: Moab to Bryce via Scenic Utah
days.summary: One of America's great scenic drives: Goblin Valley, Capitol Reef, and Scenic Byway 12 to Bryce Canyon for the afternoon and sunset.
days.driveSummary: Moab to Bryce Canyon City via Capitol Reef and Scenic Byway 12.
days.eveningNote: Overnight in Bryce Canyon City. Sunrise comes early tomorrow.

days.title: Bryce Sunrise to Zion
days.summary: Bryce Amphitheater at first light, then descend to Zion Canyon for the afternoon. Overnight in Springdale at the park's doorstep.
days.heroMoment: Bryce Canyon sunrise over the hoodoos
days.driveSummary: Bryce to Springdale via the Zion-Mount Carmel Highway.
days.eveningNote: Overnight in Springdale. Check shuttle times for the morning.

days.title: Zion to Idaho Falls
days.summary: A last Zion morning if energy allows, then a big repositioning drive north with a Cedar Breaks stop.
days.driveSummary: Springdale to Idaho Falls via Cedar Breaks National Monument.
days.eveningNote: Overnight in Idaho Falls. Stage for the Tetons.

days.title: Grand Teton to Jackson
days.summary: North-to-south Teton day: Oxbow Bend, Signal Mountain, Jenny Lake, Cathedral Group, and Mormon Row if the light holds.
days.heroMoment: Oxbow Bend reflections and Mormon Row barns
days.driveSummary: Idaho Falls over Teton Pass, north through the park, then into Jackson.
days.eveningNote: First of two nights in Jackson (booked).

days.title: Jackson Adventure Day
days.summary: Whitewater rafting on the Snake River and a relaxed evening in Jackson. No driving day.
days.eveningNote: Second night in Jackson (booked). Prep for the biggest day of the trip.

days.title: Yellowstone and Beartooth
days.summary: Greatest-hits Yellowstone: Old Faithful, Grand Prismatic, the Grand Canyon of the Yellowstone, and Lamar Valley, then out the Northeast Entrance and over Beartooth Highway to Billings.
days.heroMoment: Grand Prismatic, the Yellowstone canyon, and Beartooth Highway
days.driveSummary: Jackson through Yellowstone to Billings via Beartooth Highway. Long day—protect the schedule.
days.eveningNote: Overnight in Billings. Celebrate surviving the big one.

days.title: Billings to Deadwood
days.summary: Devils Tower is the high-payoff break between Billings and Deadwood: visitor center, Tower Trail, and the prairie dog town.
days.heroMoment: Devils Tower rising off the prairie
days.driveSummary: Billings to Deadwood with a Devils Tower detour.
days.eveningNote: Overnight in Deadwood. Prefer a low-smoke environment.

days.title: Deadwood to Marion via Mount Rushmore
days.summary: Mount Rushmore in morning light, a brief Crazy Horse stop, then the long run home to Marion.
days.driveSummary: Deadwood to Mount Rushmore and Crazy Horse, then home to Marion, IA.
days.eveningNote: Home. Start the photo backup tonight.
